settings.label: Logo
settings.info: SVG recommended. The brand guidelines set a minimum display height of 57 px for the full lockup.

settings.label: Logo height
settings.info: Cannot go below 57 px — that is the brand guidelines minimum.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Uses the logomark. Square image, at least 96 x 96 px.

settings.label: Light sage
settings.info: The brand green, lifted until it sits level with the greys. A surface only — the green band, the announcement bar and the chips. It always takes dark text; white on it is unreadable, so darkening this is what breaks the theme.

settings.label: Graphite
settings.info: The colour that acts: buttons, links, the focus ring, and small filled marks. Charcoal with a trace of the sage hue left in it. Lightening this breaks accessibility — white button labels need 4.5:1 and it currently gives 10.3:1.

settings.label: Page background
settings.info: Light grey. Brighter and greyer than the board's Warm White, so the storefront reads as light grey rather than as cream paper.

settings.content: Enquiry forms are delivered to the store's sender email, set in Shopify admin under Settings → Notifications.
